name: Thabo Dlamini
bio:
Thabo's journey into motorsport marketing began unconventionally. Initially, he was a promising rugby player sidelined by an injury. During his recovery, he volunteered at a local racing event, discovering a passion for the sport's energy and the intricate marketing strategies behind it. This sparked a career change, leading him to pursue marketing qualifications and internships within South African motorsport teams.

He joined Team WRT three years ago, bringing a fresh perspective to their marketing initiatives. Thabo is known for his data-driven approach, constantly analyzing campaign performance to optimize results. He’s not afraid to experiment with new platforms and technologies, making him a valuable asset to the team's marketing efforts. His loyalty to the team is unwavering, and he consistently goes above and beyond to achieve their marketing goals. However, he prefers working independently, excelling when given autonomy and clear objectives.

physical.description: Thabo has a muscular build and a friendly smile that puts people at ease.

quirks: Always has a detailed spreadsheet tracking marketing campaign metrics.
Prefers to work with noise-canceling headphones, even in quiet environments.
Has a habit of drumming his fingers on his desk when deep in thought.
